Author: Vivek Kumar Birla
Bench: Vivek Kumar Birla
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 45
Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 2678 of 2023
Petitioner :- Suraj Baranwal And 5 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Shyam Babu Vaish

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Ajeet Kumar Baranwal,Dibya Baranwal Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
Heard Shyam Babu Vaish, learned counsel for the petitioners, Sri Ajeet Kumar Baranwal, learned counsel appearing for the informant and learned A.G.A for the State respondents.

The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R. registered as Case Crime No. 110 of 2022 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 354(A), 313 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Basti.
Further prayer has been made not to arrest the petitioner in the aforesaid case.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that there is possibility of peaceful settlement in the present case, however, learned counsel appearing for the informant stated in categorical terms that there is no possibility of compromise in view of the allegations that have been levelled in the first Suraj Baranwal And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/30175672/
1 information report and the informant has suffered injuries in the hands of the accused persons.

entities.text: Suraj Baranwal And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: At this stage, learned counsel for the petitioners sought to argue the case on merits and has argued in the defence of the accused persons.

All such factual defence is subject matter of investigation and cannot be considered while considering present petition for quashing of the F.I.R.
Learned AGA opposed the prayer for quashing of the FIR, which discloses cognizable offence.
Perusal of the impugned first information report prima facie reveals commission of cognizable offence.

Therefore, in view of the law laid down by Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of State of Haryana and others vs. Bhajan Lal and others, 1992 Supp. (1) SCC 335 and M/s Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra, AIR 2021 SC 1918 and in Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.3262/2021 (Leelavati Devi @ Leelawati & another vs. the State of Uttar Pradesh) decided on 07.10.2021, no case has been made out for interference with the impugned first information report.

sentences.text: Therefore, the writ petition is dismissed leaving it open for the petitioner to apply before the competent court for anticipatory bail/bail including benefit of Section 437 Cr.P.C. as permissible under law and in accordance with law.
